title: COVID MM-QC-v3 Protocol
author: Opentrons
materials: Upload your protocol into the OT App.

steps.title: Enter protocol parameters
steps.instruction: Input the required parameters for the run (e.g., volumes, sample identifiers) as prompted by the Opentrons App.

steps.title: Download protocol file
steps.instruction: Download the generated protocol file to your computer.

steps.title: Upload protocol to OT App
steps.instruction: In the Opentrons App, upload the downloaded protocol file.

steps.title: Arrange deck layout
steps.instruction: Set up the deck according to the provided deck map, placing the aluminum block with 24 tubes on the temperature module and loading the P1000 single‑channel GEN2 electronic pipette tip rack.

substeps.instruction: Place the aluminum block on the temperature module.
Load the P1000 single‑channel GEN2 tip rack onto the designated deck slot.

steps.title: Calibrate labware and pipette
steps.instruction: Using the OT App, calibrate the deck labware, tip rack, and the P1000 pipette (refer to support articles for calibration tips).

steps.title: Execute protocol
steps.instruction: Press “Run” in the OT App to start the transfer of master mix into the 24 tubes.
